{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection2",
  "test_code": "using System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedTypes_HaveExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing System;\nusing MessagePack;\nusing MessagePack.Resolvers;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    public enum MyEnum\n    {\n        Alpha = 0,\n        Beta = 1,\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class IntKeyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public MyEnum Status { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public class StringKeyObject\n    {\n        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n        public int Count { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [Union(0, typeof(UnionCaseA))]\n    [Union(1, typeof(UnionCaseB))]\n    public interface IMyUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionCaseA : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionCaseB : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string Text { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n    }\n\n    [GeneratedMessagePackResolver]\n    public partial class MyGeneratedResolver\n    {\n    }\n\n    [CompositeResolver(typeof(MyGeneratedResolver), typeof(StandardResolver))]\n    public partial class MyCompositeResolver\n    {\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        var messagePackRefs = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        MetadataReference[] references = frameworkRefs.Concat(messagePackRefs).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        ImmutableArray<SyntaxTree> inputTrees = compilation.SyntaxTrees.ToImmutableArray();\n        SyntaxTree[] generatedTrees = output.SyntaxTrees.Where(t => !inputTrees.Contains(t)).ToArray();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedTrees);\n\n        var generatedTypes = new List<(INamedTypeSymbol Symbol, SyntaxTree Tree)>();\n        foreach (SyntaxTree tree in generatedTrees)\n        {\n            SemanticModel model = output.GetSemanticModel(tree);\n            TypeDeclarationSyntax[] typeDecls = tree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType<TypeDeclarationSyntax>().ToArray();\n            foreach (TypeDeclarationSyntax typeDecl in typeDecls)\n            {\n                INamedTypeSymbol? symbol = model.GetDeclaredSymbol(typeDecl);\n                Assert.NotNull(symbol);\n                generatedTypes.Add((symbol!, tree));\n\n                bool hasExcludeAttrOnTree = symbol!.GetAttributes().Any(a =>\n                    a.ApplicationSyntaxReference?.SyntaxTree == tree &&\n                    a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n                Assert.True(\n                    hasExcludeAttrOnTree,\n                    $\"Generated type '{symbol.ToDisplayString()}' in '{tree.FilePath}' is missing [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? compositeResolver = generatedTypes\n            .Select(x => x.Symbol)\n            .FirstOrDefault(s => s.ToDisplayString() == \"TestNamespace.MyCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(compositeResolver);\n        Assert.Contains(compositeResolver!.GetTypeMembers(), m => m.Name == \"FormatterCache\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? generatedResolver = generatedTypes\n            .Select(x => x.Symbol)\n            .FirstOrDefault(s => s.ToDisplayString() == \"TestNamespace.MyGeneratedResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(generatedResolver);\n        Assert.Contains(generatedResolver!.GetTypeMembers(), m => m.Name == \"FormatterCache\");\n\n        string[] formattedTargets = generatedTypes\n            .Select(x => x.Symbol)\n            .SelectMany(s => s.AllInterfaces)\n            .Where(i => i.OriginalDefinition.ToDisplayString() == \"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter<T>\")\n            .Select(i => i.TypeArguments[0].ToDisplayString())\n            .Distinct()\n            .ToArray();\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestNamespace.IntKeyObject\", formattedTargets);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestNamespace.StringKeyObject\", formattedTargets);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestNamespace.MyEnum\", formattedTargets);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestNamespace.IMyUnion\", formattedTargets);\n    }\n}\n"
}
